about: Promesse's simulator (version B,): the variables only a club holds, each with the effect it starts from. Effects are odds ratios per standard deviation, applied on top of the public-data call (version A) as log-odds; every one can be overridden. Labelled a simulation everywhere it shows: nothing here was learned from a club's data.

engine_inputs.label: Youth-competition minutes, last 12 months
engine_inputs.why: The engine already weighs this input; public data sees only the youth competitions with detailed stats (the Youth League, England's PL2...), a club sees every one (División de Honor Juvenil, its B team's league). The engine's own learned coefficient applies.

engine_inputs.label: Height
engine_inputs.why: Often missing for young players in public data; a club measures it. The engine's own learned coefficient applies.

club_measures.label: Sprint (20 m), against his age group
club_measures.source: Höner et al. 2021, Frontiers in Sports and Active Living 3:638227, Table 4 (U15, combined model)

club_measures.label: Tactical skills (coach's rating)
club_measures.source: Höner et al. 2021, Table 4 (U15, combined model)

club_measures.label: Dribbling test
club_measures.source: Höner et al. 2021, Table 4 (U15, combined model)

club_measures.label: Kicking skills (coach's rating)
club_measures.source: Höner et al. 2021, Table 4: 1.36 at U14, not significant at U15

club_measures.label: Psychosocial skills (coach's rating)
club_measures.source: Höner et al. 2021, Table 4: 0.85 at U12, not significant at U15

club_measures.label: Endurance
club_measures.source: Höner et al. 2021, Table 4: not significant at U15

club_measures.label: Biological maturity (late to early, against his age)
club_measures.source: A 14-year follow-up of 47 players of one top academy (2025) found late maturers more likely to turn professional; too small to set a number

club_measures.label: Football practice and play hours in childhood
club_measures.source: Ford & Williams 2011 (32 English academy players): those who turned professional had played and practised more; no effect size to carry over

club_measures.label: Hope for success against fear of failure
club_measures.source: Wachsmuth, Feichtinger, Bartley & Höner 2023: both predicted professional status from U17; effect sizes not carried over here

club_measures.label: Days lost to injury, last 12 months
club_measures.source: No study found with an effect on reaching a senior first team; the medical record is the club's

club_measures.label: Training load tolerated
club_measures.source: No study found with an effect on reaching a senior first team

caveats: The study effects were measured on a different outcome (reaching a professional academy within three seasons, players aged 12 to 15) and are carried over as a starting assumption.

The public-data call already reflects part of what these measure (a better player plays more and higher), so adding the effects on top counts some of it twice: read them as an upper bound on what's new.
With every slider at his age group's average, the simulation returns the public-data call exactly.
